title: Here are all the features coming to your Apple Watch with the huge new software update that's out today (AAPL)
text:
Monday, 17 September 2018 ( 15 hours ago )
Later on Monday, Apple will begin rolling out WatchOS 5 — the operating system that powers the increasingly-popular Apple Watch .
The rollout of WatchOS 5 comes about a week ahead of the launch of the Apple Watch Series 4, the next generation of the wearable device. But if you already own an Apple Watch Series 1 or Series 3, ... 👓 View full article
